urls.title: Websites
urls.description: Domains or URLs to analyze, one per line. Bare domains work (the https:// scheme is added automatically). Each successfully analyzed website is one paid result. Paste thousands at once, or link a file below.

urlListUrl.title: Or: link to a list of websites
urlListUrl.description: A link to a text or CSV file with one domain or URL per line, for lists too long to paste: a Google Sheets "Publish to the web" CSV link works. The first cell on each line that looks like a domain is used, so header rows and extra columns are fine. Read in addition to the list above.

includeDns.title: Include DNS checks
includeDns.description: Also inspect TXT, MX, NS and CNAME records to detect email providers, DNS hosting, domain verification services and CDNs.

includeEvidence.title: Include evidence
includeEvidence.description: Attach the matched header, script, cookie or HTML snippet for every detected technology so you can verify each detection.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Drop technologies detected with confidence below this value (0-100). Implied technologies typically score 50-100.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to analyze in parallel. Leave empty to scale with the run's memory, which also sets its CPU: 40 at the default 4 GB, 20 at 2 GB.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per website (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a website after this many seconds.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use Apify Proxy or your own proxies for websites that block datacenter traffic. Most websites do not need this.
